description: This file defines the class PdfNamedDestinationParameters, which provides static factory methods for creating parameter strings used to specify destinations in PDF documents, such as fits, positions, and zoom levels. It encapsulates various methods to generate destination parameter strings for different viewing options within a PDF viewer.

classes.name: PdfNamedDestinationParameters
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate PDF named destination parameter strings, used for specifying different view positions or zoom levels in PDF documents.

methods.name: CreateXYZ
methods.description: Private static method to create a parameter string with specified left, top, and zoom values.

methods.name: CreateUnchangedPosition
methods.description: Creates a parameter string that indicates no change in position on the page.

methods.name: CreateVerticalPosition
methods.description: Creates a parameter string with a specified top (vertical position) and optional zoom.

methods.name: CreatePosition
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for specific left, top, and zoom values.

methods.name: CreatePosition (XPoint overload)
methods.description: Creates a parameter string based on a point representing left and top positions with optional zoom.

methods.name: CreateFit
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the entire page.

methods.name: CreateFitHorizontally
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the page horizontally at a specific top.

methods.name: CreateFitVertically
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the page vertically at a specific left.

methods.name: CreateFitRectangle
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting a specified rectangle (via coordinates or XRect) to the view.

methods.name: CreateFitBoundingBox
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the page's bounding box.

methods.name: CreateFitBoundingBoxHorizontally
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the bounding box horizontally at a specific top.

methods.name: CreateFitBoundingBoxVertically
methods.description: Creates a parameter string for fitting the bounding box vertically at a specific left.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Static method for formatting the parameter string with provided values, handling nulls.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the stored parameters string representing the destination parameters.
